exact_claim_text: Within the synthetic tasks, response performance meets the declared threshold and most tasks are completed, while qualitative episodes expose unresolved keyboard-navigation and notification-timing barriers.
method_or_source: Build-and-evaluate performance targets, quantitative task outcomes and qualitative explanations integrated through a predeclared joint display.
uncertainty: Synthetic sample, local prototype, limited assistive-technology coverage and integration choices.
boundary: Local prototype, controlled tasks, illustrative synthetic sample and no production deployment or universal accessibility claim.
counter_evidence_or_alternative: Keyboard-only navigation fails one critical path and several participants miss time-limited notifications.
stronger_wording_rejected: The prototype is accessible and ready for campus deployment.
